messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: P1 - us-east-1a: elevated inference 5xx and DNS resolution failures. Observed start at 5865432000. Autoscaling attach failures and resolver timeouts. Paging primary oncall.
Priya_oncall: Got it - taking lead. Looking at dashboards now. Noting backend 502/504 spike and a steady stream of `InstanceAttachFailure` in control-plane logs.
Max_infra: Seeing a correlated spike of EC2 API 5xx and `RequestLimitExceeded` on DescribeInstances and AttachVolume calls when targeting us-east-1a. Also spotted recent AZ event: "Reduced network throughput" from provider console.
Jules_net: From the network side: DNS query latencies from host pool in us-east-1a jumped to 300-600ms, and we started seeing NXDOMAIN bursts. Traceroutes show intermittent drop at the local resolver hop.
Ravi_runtime: Inference frontends are experiencing long queue times and KV cache pressure. Fallbacks to other zones kicking in but some tenants pinned to us-east-1a are seeing hard failures.
Marta_support: Triage: 12 active tickets referencing increased errors; at least 2 enterprise customers report degraded throughput. Drafting an initial comms.
Priya_oncall: Immediate mitigations: 1) Pause new launches into us-east-1a to stop hammering control-plane, 2) Update routing to prefer other AZs in-region, 3) Apply DNS bypass to critical frontends.
Max_infra: Executing pause for ephemeral launches: `rbctl capacity set --zone us-east-1a --allow-new false`
Max_infra: Result: `OK` (5865432110). Also reducing autoscaler retry concurrency.
Jules_net: Implementing resolver override on frontends to point to 10.0.9.5 (alt-resolver) via config push: ``for host in $(fleet list --zone us-east-1a); do ssh $host 'sudo sed -i "s/^nameserver.*/nameserver 10.0.9.5/" /etc/resolv.conf && systemctl restart inference-frontend'; done``
Jules_net: Batch roll started. Batch 1 success 10/10, Batch 2 success 9/10, Batch 3 partial - 2 hosts failed restart due to attach errors. Current alt-resolver coverage: 27/31 hosts.
Priya_oncall: Routing change: applying short-term policy to prefer us-east-1b then us-east-1c, with cross-AZ sticky off. Command: `rbctl routing set --region us-east-1 --prefer=us-east-1b,us-east-1c --sticky=false`
Ops-bot: deploy: routing-policy v2026.03.15-19 applied to 28/28 routers (5865432165).
Ravi_runtime: Observed immediate improvement: global error rate for the region down from 9.8% -> 3.1%. Tail latencies improved for rerouted traffic, but pinned tenants still face errors.
Marta_support: Notifying affected customers: "We're investigating an issue impacting inference in us-east-1a; we've initiated routing changes to reduce impact and will offer migration assistance." Sending list to CS.
Max_infra: Opening AWS case: CASE-5865432 "EC2 control-plane throttling and AZ network impact". Requested expedited review and details on AZ-level event.
Jules_net: Temporary tweak: bumped local resolver cache TTL on frontends to 120s to reduce query volume: `sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established=120` (rolling change).
Ravi_runtime: Note: KV cache churn spiked when traffic switched; token-cost increased. I'll temporarily relax eviction policy: `runtime-config set kv.eviction=lazy` to stabilize.
Priya_oncall: Dedicated pools: confirmed 4 Dedicated tenants are pinned to us-east-1a and cannot auto-failover. Carlos_sre (not oncall) recommended manual pool migration earlier; we need to offer that.
Marta_support: Two dedicated customers requested immediate migration. Scheduling with infra to create compat pools in us-east-1b/us-east-1c.
Max_infra: Creating compat pool in us-east-1c and pre-warming models: `rbctl pool create --zone us-east-1c --type compat --prewarm=true` -> returned pool id pool-5865432. Pre-warm started.
Ops-bot: pool-create: pool-5865432 prewarm job queued (5865432250).
Priya_oncall: Handoff: I'll shadow until pre-warms are confirmed then hand primary to Hannah for monitoring and postmortem.
Hannah_sre: Taking secondary for the next shift. I'll track migrations and AWS case.
Max_infra: AWS updated case: they're seeing elevated API throughput and are rolling a control-plane remediation. They advise a gradual re-enable of launches; ETA uncertain.
Jules_net: Alt-resolver rollout complete for all reachable frontends (30/31) - one host still failing attach operations during restart. DNS RTT now ~25-40ms for updated hosts.
Ravi_runtime: After migration of two dedicated tenants to pool-5865432, their error rate dropped to <1%. Performing pre-warm for two more tenants.
Marta_support: Customer comms updated: included steps we took and migration offers. One enterprise customer accepted migration and SLA team engaging.
Priya_oncall: Preparing controlled resume: will re-enable launches with low rate and backoff. Command: `rbctl capacity set --zone us-east-1a --allow-new true --max-rate 1 --backoff 10s`
Ops-bot: capacity change accepted (5865432355).
Max_infra: Resumed launches at restricted rate. Monitoring Attach success ratio.
Hannah_sre: Metrics check: Attach failures dropped by 80% after routing + resolver changes. Region error rate stabilized at ~1.5%. Remaining degradation isolated to the four Dedicated-only tenants.
Marta_support: SLA request from ACME Inc escalating; product and billing looped in. We're offering immediate migration and credit assessment.
Ravi_runtime: Runtime note: re-enabled token-cost alerts due to cache TTL changes. No runaway costs observed in first 30m.
Max_infra: AWS case updated: remediation completed in their control plane; they suggest monitoring for 2 hours before marking as resolved. Case moved to "actioned" with logs attached.
Priya_oncall: I'll hand primary to @Hannah_sre for the monitoring window. Hannah, please post status every 30m and capture timeline.
Hannah_sre: Taking over. Current status: mitigated -> monitoring. Actions captured: - routing pref set to prefer us-east-1b/us-east-1c - alt-resolver applied to frontends - paused and then rate-limited re-enable of launches - compat pools created + migrations for dedicated tenants.
Marta_support: All customer comms sent; CS standing by for inbound escalations.
Ravi_runtime: Proposed post-incident follow-ups: - Add automated cross-AZ routing when resolver errors > Xms, - Add explicit exponential backoff + jitter on EC2 attach/retry to reduce control-plane pressure, - Improve Dedicated migration UX (one-click pool compat/migrate).
Ops-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring (5865432488). :white_check_mark:
Hannah_sre: Will open postmortem doc and link to this thread with timeline, commands run, and customer impact summary. Closing hands off to next shift after 2h monitoring.
